verdict: Leads surging at lower cost, but none are converting to cases yet.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 58 leads at $31.13 per lead, with the most recent 7 days delivering a 180% jump in leads and a 39% drop in cost per lead — the paid campaign is clearly gaining efficiency. However, zero leads have moved into active cases in your pipeline, and zero appointments have been booked, which points to a gap in the intake process rather than the ads themselves. SMS automation and phone access, both needed to follow up on incoming leads, are still being set up and are the priority fix right now. Once intake is connected, the volume and cost improvements already in place should start converting into cases. Your Google Business Profile activity dropped sharply this past week, which we are watching closely and expect to recover as posting cadence resumes by end of September.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, the highest recent pace since the campaign re-launched
cost per lead this period, down 39% from the week prior
leads converted to cases in your pipeline — intake setup is the immediate focus

watch_item.issue: Incoming leads are not reaching your intake team — SMS follow-up automation and phone access are not yet live, meaning contacts may be going cold.
watch_item.fix: Both are being activated now as the top priority; case tracking and auto-logging in the CRM are on track to be live by end of September.
